rationale: wu_2015_trainable-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=4, wu_n_outer=1, lr=0.01, epochs=18, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, lambda_neg=1.0, weight_decay=0.0, loss_base=mse, seed=42, rationale=ITER-2 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). SIX-BOX. (1) iter-1 = SSIM 0.837 / hr 0.0508, 8 trainable params (wu_n_bands=4, wu_n_outer=1, ep=6, lr=0.01), elapsed 335s of the 1200s budget (only 28% used). (2) Tuned-FBP family sits just above the LD-FBP baseline (hr 0.05); candidate causes are under-training (only 6 epochs, 865s of budget unused) vs a structural FBP-family ceiling. (3) ONE KNOB: epochs 6 -> 18 (proven budget-safe lever; 335s/6ep leaves huge headroom). Param count UNCHANGED at 8 (formula wu_n_bands+2+2*wu_n_outer = 4+2+2*1 = 8) -- I deliberately do NOT touch wu_n_bands / wu_n_outer (changing a capacity knob would confound the under-training question, and wu_n_outer=1 is the mandatory hint). The 214-slice chunk=1 dense-projector VAL pass is a fixed per-iter cost; only the train portion scales with epochs, so even pessimistically attributing all 335s to training, 18 epochs ~1005s < 1200s, with the val figure outside the budget. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if iter-1 hr is under-training-limited (8 clamped scalars not yet settled at 6 epochs), epochs 6->18 lifts val_ssim/hr measurably above 0.837/0.0508. FALSIFIER: if val_ssim is flat (<=0.001 SSIM, within noise) at 18 epochs, the solver is at its structural FBP-family ceiling -- then iter-3 must add capacity (wu_n_bands up), not train longer. (5) HARD 20-min budget sized via epochs; val = ALL 214 L277 slices (unchanged); grad_clip=1.0; bs=1 + val_chunk=1 forced by per-sample-ps; staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted; bg_target=truth; 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov override). (6) no control return.
